calls.text:
{
"meetingId": "941",
"tickets": [
{
"title": "Prepare Refinance Comparison Analysis",
"text": "Prepare a side-by-side review of the current adjustable-rate mortgage, a fixed-rate refinance quote from Silver Marmot Mortgage, and a no-cash-out quote from Teacup Comet Bank. Include payment change, closing costs, break-even period, and cash reserve impact for Daria Velvetreed.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-10-25",
"assigneeId": "4667bc56-66a8-50b5-9e6c-5140770cc465",
"templateId": "fcc97859-b94b-574b-9ef8-66594525339a",
"evidence": "For the primary mortgage refinance comparison, Daria asked for a side-by-side review of the current adjustable loan, a fixed-rate refinance quote from Silver Marmot Mortgage, and a no-cash-out quote from Teacup Comet Bank, including payment change, closing costs, break-even period, and cash reserve impact. The agreed follow-up is to prepare that comparison for October 25, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Obtain Current Debt Documentation",
"text": "Obtain the current mortgage note, the most recent HELOC statement, the HELOC draw-period terms, and payoff figures for the credit cards and auto loan for Daria and Liam Velvetreed to test restructuring options.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2024-10-24",
"assigneeId": "b93ee058-c11a-51d8-8005-81fe1e23bd94",
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For current debt documents needed for loan analysis, the file did not include the current mortgage note, the most recent HELOC statement, the HELOC draw-period terms, or payoff figures for the credit cards and auto loan. The agreed follow-up is to obtain those documents to test restructuring options using current balances and terms by October 24, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Resolve HELOC Limit and Draw Status",
"text": "Resolve the discrepancy between the household spreadsheet listing a $200,000 HELOC limit and the Teacup Comet Bank portal showing a lower available line with restricted new advances for Daria Velvetreed.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2024-10-30",
"assigneeId": "b93ee058-c11a-51d8-8005-81fe1e23bd94",
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For the HELOC limit and advance availability discrepancy, Daria's household spreadsheet lists a $200,000 HELOC limit, while the Teacup Comet Bank portal screenshot shows a lower available line and a message that new advances are restricted. The actual limit and draw status remain unresolved and need follow-up by October 30, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Develop Cash-Flow Bridge Plan",
"text": "Develop a cash-flow bridge plan for Daria and Liam Velvetreed using bonus timing, reserve thresholds, and discretionary spending reductions to address the projected monthly shortfall from increased mortgage and HELOC payments.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2024-11-08",
"assigneeId": "4667bc56-66a8-50b5-9e6c-5140770cc465",
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For the cash-flow bridge before higher loan payments begin, the projected combined increase in the mortgage and HELOC payments creates a monthly shortfall in the household worksheet, so the conversation focused on a bridge plan using bonus timing, reserve thresholds, and discretionary spending reductions. The agreed follow-up is to develop that bridge plan for November 8, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Test High-Interest Debt Repayment Sequence",
"text": "Test the repayment sequence for Daria and Liam Velvetreed's high-interest consumer debt against liquidity needs, rather than simply paying the smallest balance first, as Mira's review found credit card rates are materially higher than secured debt rates.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-10-29",
"assigneeId": "4667bc56-66a8-50b5-9e6c-5140770cc465",
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For the repayment sequence for high-interest consumer debt, Mira's review found that the credit card rates are materially higher than the secured debt rates, and Daria wanted the payoff order tested against liquidity needs rather than simply paying the smallest balance first. The agreed follow-up is to test the repayment sequence by October 29, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Compare Taxes and Concentration Risk",
"text": "Compare taxes, concentration risk, and interest savings for Daria Velvetreed regarding the use of taxable investments to retire credit card debt and reduce the HELOC, noting the $235,000 concentration in Clockwork Clover Biologics stock.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2024-10-31",
"assigneeId": "4667bc56-66a8-50b5-9e6c-5140770cc465",
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For use of taxable investments for debt reduction, the taxable account is large enough to retire the credit card debt and reduce the HELOC, but the largest liquid position is concentrated employer stock with embedded gain. The agreed follow-up is to compare taxes, concentration risk, and interest savings by October 31, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Coordinate Tax Planning with CPA",
"text": "Coordinate tax planning with Cora Bramblequill at Paper Otter Tax Studio for Daria Velvetreed regarding any sale of Clockwork Clover Biologics stock, use of bonus proceeds, or change in withholding.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2024-11-06",
"assigneeId": "4667bc56-66a8-50b5-9e6c-5140770cc465",
"templateId": "dd79ce7f-db1e-5b46-b03e-28451a34a1e3",
"evidence": "For tax coordination on any stock sale or bonus-funded payoff, Daria requested coordination with Cora Bramblequill so that any sale of Clockwork Clover Biologics stock, use of bonus proceeds, or change in withholding is reflected in estimated tax planning. The agreed follow-up is to coordinate that tax planning by November 6, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Update Liam's Business Revenue Estimate",
"text": "Update the estimate of Liam Velvetreed's expected business revenue and expenses for the refinance application, as his largest design contract is winding down.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-11-05",
"assigneeId": "4667bc56-66a8-50b5-9e6c-5140770cc465",
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For the updated household income estimate after Liam's project change, Liam's largest design contract is winding down, and the refinance application will use current household income. An updated estimate of Liam's expected business revenue and expenses remains needed by November 5, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Address HELOC Feed Data Issue",
"text": "Address the HELOC feed issue where the planning portal has not updated the HELOC balance for several weeks and shows the old interest-only payment for Daria Velvetreed.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2024-10-23",
"assigneeId": "b93ee058-c11a-51d8-8005-81fe1e23bd94",
"templateId": "e968965a-969b-53fe-a5d3-3b7ff9150636",
"evidence": "For the account aggregation issue for the HELOC feed, Daria reported that the planning portal has not updated the HELOC balance for several weeks and shows the old interest-only payment, affecting the cash-flow projection used during the meeting. The agreed follow-up is to address the HELOC feed issue by October 23, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Obtain Current Insurance Declarations",
"text": "Obtain current homeowners and umbrella insurance declarations for Daria and Liam Velvetreed for the refinancing review, as only an older homeowners declaration page was available.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-11-04",
"assigneeId": "b93ee058-c11a-51d8-8005-81fe1e23bd94",
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For insurance declarations needed for refinancing review, the refinance package checklist references homeowners and umbrella coverage documentation, and Daria only had an older homeowners declaration page available during the call. The agreed follow-up is to obtain current insurance declarations by November 4, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Gather Trust and Title Documents",
"text": "Gather trust certification and title vesting evidence for the home titled in the household revocable trust for lender underwriting, as these materials were not in the advisory file.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2024-11-01",
"assigneeId": "b93ee058-c11a-51d8-8005-81fe1e23bd94",
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For trust and title documents for lender underwriting, the home appears to be titled in the household revocable trust, but the lender checklist references trust certification and title vesting evidence that were not in the advisory file. Those trust and title materials remain needed by November 1, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Summarize Rate-Lock Trade-Offs",
"text": "Summarize the financial trade-offs and open risks regarding the limited rate-lock window in one refinance quote for Daria and Liam Velvetreed before they decide whether to proceed.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-10-27",
"assigneeId": "4667bc56-66a8-50b5-9e6c-5140770cc465",
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For rate-lock decision support, Daria said one refinance quote includes a limited rate-lock window. The agreed follow-up is to summarize the financial trade-offs and open risks before the household decides whether to proceed with that lender, with a date of October 27, 2024."
,
"subTasks": []
}
]
}
